entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: A Fallaji nomad, son of his tribe's chieftain, who became Mishra's loyal bodyguard and a commander during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother whom Hajar came to guard; once taken hostage and made a rakiq.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's brother and opponent in the east.

entities.name: Ahmahl
entities.description: Dig site leader at Tocasia's dig site.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Suwwardi leader who made Mishra tutor to his son.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Rival of Hajar who arranged for him to leave for the mainland.

entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: Sent with Hajar by ship to the mainland.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Defender of Terisia City who died casting Hurkyl's Recall.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City besieged by Hajar's armies and betrayed by Gixians.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Nomads of Dominaria, to whom Hajar belonged.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group to which Mishra listened exclusively.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: The siege in which the city was betrayed by Gixians.

events.summary: Hajar finds that Mishra has been taken hostage and made a rakiq, and talks to the Qadir, who makes Mishra tutor to his son.
events.quote: Hajar by chance discovered that Mishra had been taken hostage and was working as a rakiq

events.summary: Hajar becomes Mishra's bodyguard and stays loyal through the Brothers' War.
events.quote: Hajar remained loyal to his charge through the duration of the Brothers' War .

events.summary: Mishra sends Hajar and his armies to besiege Terisia City; defenses hold for months until Gixians betray the city.
events.quote: When diplomacy failed, he sent Hajar and his armies to besiege the city.

events.summary: Hurkyl dies casting a spell to disappear Mishra's dragon engines.
events.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

events.summary: Hajar accompanies Mishra to Argoth, but Ashnod displaces him as closest to Mishra and arranges for him and Gwenna to board a ship, so he misses the Battle at Argoth and the Sylex Blast.
events.quote: Ashnod arranged for Hajar and Gwenna to board a ship for the mainland

relations.quote: over time, he turned into Mishra's bodyguard
